description: Hermes detection rules, from its ready status row above or below the composer.

rules.why: Hermes paints a `ready` status row directly above an empty composer after startup and each completed turn, and replaces it while running; the row's clock keeps repainting, so quiet is not asked.

all.regex: ^─ (?:(?:⚡|🔋) \d{1,3}% │ )?ready [│|][^\n]*\n(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦)(?: Ask me anything…| Try "/help" for commands| Try "(?:explain this codebase|write a test for…|refactor the auth module|fix the lint errors|how does the config loader work\?)")?[ \t]*$

rules.why: With `display.tui_statusbar: bottom` Hermes paints the same ready row directly below the empty composer.

all.regex: ^(?:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} )?(?:❯|⚔|Ψ|◉|✦)(?: Ask me anything…| Try "/help" for commands| Try "(?:explain this codebase|write a test for…|refactor the auth module|fix the lint errors|how does the config loader work\?)")?[ \t]*\n─ (?:(?:⚡|🔋) \d{1,3}% │ )?ready [│|][^\n]*
